assign.outcome:
**AI 2 now opens on seven familiar groups instead of a wall of ids, and clicking one shows the real task pages inside it.**

- **See it:** [/framework/ai2/](/framework/ai2/). The rail leads with System design · Servex · AI dashboard · Pages & markdown · Cards & content · Layout & columns · Audits. Each has an icon, the latest update written out in full, and when. The busiest group sits on top. No slugs or ids appear in these previews.
- **A card is the task page:** clicking a group shows its tasks' real pages as sections, newest first (outcome, links, steps, decisions). Clicking a task card shows that task's page. This reuses the task page's own code, `AITask.into()`, rather than copying it.
- **Filing:** every one of today's 27 tasks is filed into a group. Moving one is a single `{"group": …}` line, and the latest line wins. The group list is [`ai2/groups.json`](/framework/ai2/groups.json), and the fast assistant will read it to file each new prompt into an existing group first (assistant-layers is wiring that now).
- **Previews are never cut off.** The old 355 cards are folded under "Not filed yet".
- **Nothing clobbered:** no padding or gap changed on /framework/ai/, /framework/ or /framework/styles/, and the padding law passes on AI 2 at every width.
